nodes.name: architecture_design.md
nodes.summary: Overview of the monorepo structure describing sibling top-level directories for Edge Functions, shared code, scripts, and tests, all governed by deno.json. Details the CI workflow with parallel quality and stack jobs.
nodes.languageNotes: Describes the overall project structure: supabase/functions, supabase/functions/_shared, scripts, tests, deno.json central task surface, and GitHub Actions CI.

nodes.name: coding_conventions.md
nodes.summary: Coding conventions for the Deno monorepo: centralized task declarations, pinned remote dependencies via import aliases, generated artifact exclusions, and permission differences between unit and integration tests.

nodes.name: overview.md
nodes.summary: High-level overview of the Setura monorepo: a Deno-based root wiring Supabase Edge Functions, shared TypeScript layer, scripts, and tests behind a single deno.json task surface and GitHub Actions CI.

nodes.name: tech_stack.md
nodes.summary: Lists the core technology stack: Deno v2.8.3 runtime and task runner, Supabase CLI for local DB/Functions orchestration, Zod for runtime schema validation, @supabase/supabase-js for client access, and GitHub Actions for CI.

nodes.name: unique_setup_and_commands.md
nodes.summary: Documents the set of custom Deno tasks available in the monorepo: type-checking, unit tests, integration tests (requires running Supabase stack), migration validation, and database type generation.

nodes.name: _module.yaml
nodes.summary: Qoder module metadata file defining the root module scope: deno.json, deno.lock, audit/cross-check reports, roadmap, CI workflow, environment example, and Supabase log artifacts.
